Welcome to Epoch Tech Fest, an exciting annual technology festival organized by Gitam Bengaluru! This event showcases cutting-edge innovations, hosts engaging workshops, and brings together tech enthusiasts from across the country.
## Epoch Coins System

We've incorporated a special Epoch Coins system to enhance your experience:

1. Initial Allocation: Upon purchasing your ticket (e.g., ₹199), you'll receive 398 Epoch Coins (1 INR = 2 Epoch Coins).

2. Usage: Use these coins to:
 - Access various booths (e.g., 40 coins for VR booth)
 - Participate in games (e.g., 60 coins)
 - Buy exclusive merchandise (e.g., 80 coins)

3. Recharge Points: If you run low on coins, earn more at Recharge Points:
 - Complete quick activities like tech trivia or mini-coding puzzles
 - Each Recharge Point allows one recharge per participant
 - Earn around 20 Epoch Coins per recharge

4. Real-time Tracking: Your coin balance and transactions are tracked on your event profile.

This system provides flexibility and choice in tailoring your Epoch Tech Fest experience, ensuring a memorable journey into the world of technology!
